children: Hotels-to-drinks group Endeavour's newest bear says the consumer backdrop is likely to worsen before it improves. Jefferies says Endeavour's retail arm is gaining a larger share of the market. Retail sales rose by 3.0%, compared to a 1.3% drop by Coles's liquor business. However, Australia's liquor market remains subdued. Weak consumer sentiment is compounding structural consumption headwinds, leaving sales growth well below cost inflation, analyst Michael Simotas says. "Exit run rate weakened materially and promotion remains elevated, pressuring margins," Jefferies says. "Hotel revenue is also weak, with gaming softness a margin headwind." Jefferies downgrades Endeavour to underperform, from hold, and lowers its price target by 3.4% to A$2.80/share. Endeavour ended last week at A$3.39.(david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
